title: Modified variable queryClient to retry a failed query once
context: A page that loads data showed its failure after one failed request. A failed load is now requested a second time before the page shows the failure. One dropped request no longer costs the shopper the page.

- **When** a shopper opens the catalogue and the first request for the products fails, **then** [the app sends the request a second time](code:src/lib/query-client.ts#queryClient), and the page shows "Loading the catalogue…" until that request ends.
- **When** both requests for the products fail, **then** the page shows "The catalogue could not be loaded." after two requests, where it showed that text after one.

- **When** a shopper opens the account page and the first request for the profile fails, **then** [the app sends the request a second time](code:src/lib/query-client.ts#queryClient), and the page shows the profile form when that request succeeds.
- **When** a request for the products or the profile fails with a status that a second request cannot change, such as 404, **then** the app still sends the request a second time.
- **When** the first request for the products or the profile succeeds, **then** nothing changes.
- **When** a shopper saves the profile and that request fails, **then** nothing changes.
- Added the constant [`RETRY_COUNT`](code:src/lib/query-client.ts#RETRY_COUNT) with the value `1`.
- Modified [`queryClient`](code:src/lib/query-client.ts#queryClient) to set `retry` to `RETRY_COUNT` in its default query options, where it set `false`.

files.title: Queries retry once after a failure
summary: Added the constant [`RETRY_COUNT`](code:src/lib/query-client.ts#RETRY_COUNT) with the value `1`.
Modified [`queryClient`](code:src/lib/query-client.ts#queryClient) to set `retry` to `RETRY_COUNT` in its default query options, where it set `false`.

waypoints.title: Added `RETRY_COUNT` with the value `1`
waypoints.reading: The author added a constant `RETRY_COUNT` that holds `1`, the number of times a failed query runs again. [`queryClient` reads it as the `retry` of its default query options](code:src/lib/query-client.ts#queryClient), so that every query with no `retry` of its own runs a second time after a failure.

waypoints.title: Modified `queryClient` to retry a failed query once
waypoints.reading: The author modified a constant `queryClient` that now sets `retry` to [`RETRY_COUNT`](code:src/lib/query-client.ts#RETRY_COUNT), which is `1`, in its default query options, where it set `false`. A query that fails now runs its query function a second time before it reports the error. `src/main.tsx` passes `queryClient` to `<QueryClientProvider />`, so that `useProducts()` in `src/hooks/use-products.ts` and `useProfile()` in `src/hooks/use-profile.ts`, which set no `retry`, send a failed request again. `useUpdateProfile()` in `src/hooks/use-profile.ts` calls `useMutation()`, and the `queries` options do not apply to a mutation.
waypoints.needsAttention: This is the one place where the behaviour changes: every query of the app that sets no `retry` now sends its request twice before it reports an error. [`RETRY_COUNT`](code:src/lib/query-client.ts#RETRY_COUNT) only names the value.
